name: City Council - 6:00 p.m.
agenda_text:
City of Encinitas
City Council - 6:00 p.m.
AGENDA
WEDNESDAY, MARCH 12, 2014 -
6:00
p.m.
City of Encinitas - City Council Chambers
505 S. Vulcan Avenue
Encinitas, California 92024
Each speaker is allowed three (3) minutes to address the City Council.
1.
CALL TO ORDER
2.
ROLL CALL
3.
PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE
4.
SPECIAL PRESENTATIONS AND PROCLAMATIONS
4A.
Proclamation to Rancho Coastal Humane Society and SNAP proclaiming "Spay Day USA" in the City of Encinitas.
4B.
Presentation from SANDAG regarding the status of the Coastal Rail Trail.
5.
ORAL COMMUNICATIONS / POSSIBLE DIRECTION TO STAFF (30 MINUTES)
Each speaker is allowed three (3) minutes to address the City Council. Time donations are not permitted during Oral Communications. Please submit a "WHITE" speaker slip to the City Clerk. If at least two Council Members agree, direction may be given to staff to put an item on a future agenda or provide additional information to answer a question.
6.
REPORT FROM CLOSED SESSION (IF HELD)
7.
CHANGES TO THE AGENDA Announcements of administrative changes to the agenda, in compliance with the Brown Act.
8.
CONSENT CALENDAR The recommendations on the following Consent Calendar will be enacted in one motion unless an item is removed from the Calendar. Any member of the public may remove an item by submitting a "PINK" speaker slip to the City Clerk. Items removed from the Consent Calendar by a Council Member or the public will be considered immediately following the Consent Calendar.
8A.
Approval of the Minutes of the 2/19/14 Regular Meeting. Contact Person: City Clerk Hollywood
Approve the Minutes.
2014-03-12 Item #8A Minutes
8B.
Approval of the Warrants List. Contact Person: Finance Manager Lundgren
Approve the Warrants List.
2014-03-12 Item #8B Warrants
8C.
Resolution 2014-17 Authorizing Application for the Emerging Cities Program. Contact Person: Deputy City Manager Phillips
Adopt City Council Resolution 2014-17 approving submittal of application for the Energy Efficiency Emerging Cities Program.
2014-03-12 Item #8C Resolution 2014-17 Emerging Cities Program Application
9.
ITEMS REMOVED FROM THE CONSENT CALENDAR Staff reports will be given only if requested by the person who pulled the item.
10.
ACTION ITEMS
10A.
Discussion and direction regarding duties and salary for the elected Mayor position and selection process for Deputy Mayor. Contact Person: City Clerk Hollywood
Provide direction to staff regarding the establishment of duties and salary for the elected Mayor position and the selection process for Deputy Mayor.
2014-03-12 Item #10A Mayor Duties & Salary - Deputy Mayor Selection
10B.
Discussion and direction regarding potential ballot measure establishing term limits for Elected Mayor and Council. Contact Person: City Clerk Hollywood
Provide direction to staff regarding a potential ballot measure establishing term limits for Elected Mayor and Council.
2014-03-12 Item #10B Term Limits Ballot Measure
10C.
Election related items for Council consideration and possible action/direction to staff regarding: A) Temporarily designating a Council seat to a two-year term to evenly stagger the election of Council Members due to the establishment of an elected Mayor; B) The impact of the Citizens United decision on the City's campaign contribution limits and the possible adoption of Resolution No. 2014-19 entitled: "A Resolution of the City of Encinitas in Support of a Constitutional Amendment to Overturn Citizens United;" and C) Campaign contribution limits. Contact Person: City Attorney Sabine
Receive reports and possible action/direction to staff.
2014-03-12 Item #10C Election Related Items
10D.
Informational report on a transactions and use tax for the City of Encinitas. Contact Person: Finance Director Nash
Information and direction to staff as necessary. (Amended recommendation.)
2014-03-12 Item #10D Transactions and Use Tax Informational Report
12.
COUNCIL MEMBER INITIATED AGENDA ITEM
12A.
Council initiated item from Council Member Kranz regarding letter to Encinitas Union School District Board
2014-03-12 Item #12A Proposed Pacific View Letter From Mayor to EUSD
11.
INFORMATIONAL ITEMS
11A.
Interstate 5 Widening Project Status Update (standing agenda item per Council direction) Contact Person: Associate Planner Strong
Receive report and provide direction to staff as appropriate.
2014-03-12 Item #11A Interstate 5 Widening Project
13.
FUTURE AGENDA ITEMS ADDED BY COUNCIL MEMBERS
14.
CITY COUNCIL MEMBER REPORTS PURSUANT TO AB1234 (GC 53232.3(d) / POSSIBLE DIRECTION TO STAFF
15.
CITY MANAGER REPORTS / PENDING FUTURE AGENDA ITEMS
16.
CITY ATTORNEY REPORTS
17.
ADJOURNMENT
Notice to the Public:
To ensure that the City meets your needs when addressing the City Council, all presentation materials which require the use of visual equipment need to be submitted to the City's IT Division at least 24 hours in advance of the meeting (except for appeal hearings where materials must be submitted 7 days in advance). This includes photographs, Microsoft Office documents (PowerPoint, Word, Excel). No CD's, DVD's, or USB thumb/flash drives will be accepted at the meeting. All materials must be in PC format and digital presentation items must be emailed to it-service-desk@encinitasca.gov . Please label all materials with the corresponding agenda item number. Should technical assistance be necessary, it will be available to presenters from 5:30 p.m. to 5:50 p.m. on the day of the meeting. Presentation of video/digital/photographs are considered part of the maximum time limit provided to speakers.
